title: Modpack Medievaleggiante
body:
Medieval themed modpack that greatly changes the way you play the game

![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cbfd758e162f6114841622a2438a53067f8cb3e_0.webp)

**Features**:
- 4 new bosses ([bosses of mass destruction](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction))
- 300+ new weapons
- 15+ new armor sets
- new biomes and structures to explore
- warden dimension ([deeper and darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker))
- free multiplayer ([essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential))
- combat animations ([better combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat))
  
  and more...
